system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: the prompt consists of three key components: (1) a description of the target Java architecture, including its shared in-terfaces; (2) retrieved examples of PL/SQL–to–Java translation pairs; and (3) the PL/SQL code snippet serves as the input for translation.
system_prompt_style.note: Paper-only; the prompt is composed of an architecture description, retrieved examples and the source snippet. Whether this is a single template or dynamic composition is not shown. No code available.

env_context_strategy.note: Dense retrieval of few-shot PL/SQL->Java pairs. An LLM also shortlists APIs from a curated knowledge base.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: This process repeats until the code compiles successfully, passes all associated test cases, or reaches a predefined termination criterion.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: The resulting shortlisted APIs are then passed to the Refinement Agent to guide the next correction step.
delegation_mechanism.note: Fixed hand-off between stages; closest value is role_handoff.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: The refinement loop continues until the code compiles successfully or until no additional test cases pass after a refinement step.
